{ alarm: false, state_update: false }"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="690" y="327" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="210" y="327" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ka_note" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#666666;" value="nothing changed → carry on.
(repeats every 1 s, forever)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="300" x="300" y="333" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dash_note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=10;align=left;" value="🖥 Meanwhile, someone clicks LED in the dashboard:
POST /toggle/led → hub sets pending_state_update = true" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="400" x="470" y="398" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ka2_req" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="PUT /api/houses/<uid>/keepalive"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="210" y="470" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="690" y="470" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ka2_resp" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=open;dashed=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="200 OK
{ alarm: false, state_update: TRUE }"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="690" y="512" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="210" y="512" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="su_note" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#666666;" value="state_update is TRUE → so the house follows up with a GET" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="360" x="270" y="518" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="get_req" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="GET /api/houses/<uid>/state"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="210" y="560" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="690" y="560" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="get_resp" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=open;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="200 OK
{ led:{active:true}, fan:{…},

So one tiny heartbeat reply can say both "buzz now" and "go pull your new state"." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="840" x="40" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg_req" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#d6b656;" value="solid = request (house → hub)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="240" x="40" y="772" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg_resp" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#82b366;" value="dashed = response (hub → house)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="260" x="300" y="772" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
